# Idle Air Control Valve Cleaning Procedure

**Make**: Honda
**Model**: Civic
**Year**: 2008
**Diagnostic Code**: P0505

## Description and Procedure
Rough idle hunting between 500 and 1200 RPM typically indicates carbon buildup in the throttle body and IAC passage.
Vehicle system troubleshooting guidance for P0505 on 2008 Honda Civic.
Always adhere to shop safety practices when servicing engine systems.
